meeting.title: Ashby weekly sync — embedded analytics
meeting.summary: Weekly sync on Ashby's embedded analytics rollout. Repo connection confirmed done Monday; Theo to draft the embed JWT auth example, Lena to ship the staging embed page by the 10th.
action_items: Theo to draft the embed JWT auth example by next Wednesday
Lena to ship the staging embed page by July 10
key_decisions: Customer-facing dashboards embed via signed JWTs, one token per tenant
meeting.notes: Tenant isolation via JWT claims agreed in principle; example code needed before Lena's team builds.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Hey Lena. First up — did the repo connection go through after we fixed the deploy key?

transcript.speaker: Lena Brouwer
transcript.text: Yes, we hooked the dbt repo up on Monday and it compiles on every push now. That task is done.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Great. So the interesting part this week is the embedded side — dashboards inside your ATS product.

transcript.speaker: Lena Brouwer
transcript.text: Right. Each customer should only ever see their own hiring data. How does tenant isolation work in the embed?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Signed JWTs. Your backend mints a token per tenant with their filters baked into the claims, and the embed honors it.

transcript.speaker: Lena Brouwer
transcript.text: That fits our auth model. My team will need a working example before they build against it though.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Fair. I'll draft the embed JWT auth example with a sample token and claims for your stack by next Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Lena Brouwer
transcript.text: Perfect. Then we'll ship the staging embed page with one dashboard wired in by the 10th — we want it demoable for our own sprint review.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Love that deadline. Anything else blocking?

transcript.speaker: Lena Brouwer
transcript.text: Not blocking. At some point we should discuss usage-based pricing for embedded seats, but that's a commercial chat.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: I'll flag it to the account team informally, no action needed from you.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Short ones are the good ones. Speak next week.
